name: Data Grid Improvements in Data Warehouse & SQL Endpoint - Milestone 1
description: The Data Grid feature for data warehouses and SQL analytics endpoints includes:* Data Handling: Supports large datasets with virtualization for performance.* Performance Optimization: Virtual scrolling, row virtualization, and lazy loading.* Search: Search across columns.* Column & Row Features: Resize and sort.* Grid-Level Options: Copy data with/without headers
